context: web site scan exited 1 with EMPTY_RESULT because the site lists no sitemap (robots.txt is missing, which is not reported as an error) and /sitemap.xml answered 404. The right move is the http strategy with a limit. Judge answer.md.

checklist.name: cause
checklist.description: Explains that the site publishes no sitemap (no Sitemap line in robots.txt and /sitemap.xml is 404), so the sitemaps strategy found no URLs; it is not a crawl bug or a bot block.

checklist.name: http_strategy
checklist.description: Gives the command `web site scan https://www.example-shop.test --strategy http` (the web CLI's own site scan, not curl loops or a hand-written crawler).

checklist.name: limit
checklist.description: Adds a --limit (the http strategy fetches every page and is unbounded without one) and, optionally, --include/--exclude patterns.

checklist.name: blocked_fallback
checklist.description: Mentions that if the http crawl is refused (bot protection) the next step is the browser-probe skill, because site scan does not drive a browser.
